BestFirst strategy always processes the seed URL first

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"crawl_strategy\":\"best_first\",\"max_concurrent\":1,\"max_depth\":1}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.crawl_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(length(result.pages))
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.pages, 0).url)
```
